name: video-player
title: Video Player
description: A framed video player with the same grouped custom transport controls as Audio Player — a file or an HLS playlist (hls.js loaded lazily where the browser has no native HLS) with signed-URL renewal at the same position, skip ranges shown as edited time, chapters, captions, picture in picture and fullscreen, a poster, no autoplay, and a "can't play" card with Download.

meta.whenToUse: A video on a page — a stored file, or a recording served as an HLS playlist with renewing signed URLs, chapters, captions and an edit previewed as skipped ranges.
meta.whenNotToUse: Opening a stored file full screen (FileViewer), caption editing, or multi-rendition streaming with a quality picker.
